implementation.targetScope: Stable createCollection API used by Menu 2.2.1 and Roving Focus 1.2.1: scoped providers, slotted refs and metadata, live DOM ordering, SSR/hydration and keyboard callers. Experimental unstable_createCollection/OrderedDict API is not implemented.

changes: One DOM-order pass replaces repeated indexOf searches during sorting.
Register committed item data in layout effects, with unchanged-data bailout and node/owner cleanup.
Omit registered items outside the current collection root, preventing detached or portalled items from appearing in its navigation list.
Use four VPM dependencies; no copied upstream runtime or unused primitive dependency.
